message.content: the login test is flaky, it sometimes can't find the session cookie. can you fix it?

content.text:
Found it. The session cookie was written after the redirect fired, so the test sometimes read an empty jar. I moved the write into the middleware, before the redirect. ```mermaid flowchart LR R[Request
GET /login] --> M[Middleware
writes sid] M --> D[Redirect
302 /home] D --> T[Test
reads sid] ``` The request reaches the middleware, which writes the cookie. Then the redirect fires, and the test always finds it. ```ts export function middleware(req: NextRequest) { const res = NextResponse.redirect(new URL("/home", req.url)) res.cookies.set("sid", issueSession(req), { httpOnly: true }) return res } ``` I ran the auth suite fifty times in a row and it passed every time. Want me to drop the retry we added to that test?
